phase_name: Author guard-path fixtures and run the falsifiability gate

objectives.description: Add synthetic Lean project helper + stub lake + stub guard helpers
Fixture G: lake present, guard absent
Fixture H: lake present, guard present + anti-vacuous check vs G
Run suite against unmodified census script; record F/G PASS, H/I FAIL split

approaches_tried.approach: path_without_lake() removing whole PATH directories containing an executable named lake
approaches_tried.reason: On this machine /run/current-system/sw/bin resolves BOTH lake and bash to the same symlink farm; blanket directory removal also removed bash, breaking Fixture F with 'bash: command not found'. Replaced with make_isolated_bin_without_lake(), which symlinks only the needed tools (bash, python3, grep, find, ...) into a fresh dir, deliberately excluding lake.

falsifiability_gate_result.observed_split: Fixtures F and G PASS (all sub-assertions); Fixtures H and I FAIL (all sub-assertions) -- exactly the expected split, proving the new fixtures discriminate guard-present from guard-absent/unmodified behavior.
falsifiability_gate_result.totals: Passed: 11, Failed: 4 (existing Fixtures A-E: 8/8 pass, unchanged)
